attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: জাগ্রত এবং চারপাশ বুঝতে পারে এমন।

definition.oewn_definition: knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts
definition.text: knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts

examples.bn: ডাক্তার আসার সময় রোগী সংজ্ঞাযুক্ত ছিল।
examples.en: The patient was conscious when the doctor arrived.

bangla_explanation.text: কোনো বিষয় জানে বা বুঝতে পেরেছে এমন।

definition.oewn_definition: (followed by ‘of’) showing realization or recognition of something
definition.text: (followed by ‘of’) showing realization or recognition of something

examples.bn: পুরোনো সেতুর ঝুঁকি সম্পর্কে সে সচেতন ছিল।
examples.en: She was conscious of the risk in the old bridge.
